name: patent-writing-chinese
title_zh: 技术交底书变Word专利稿，仿宋黑体公式图表一步到位
tagline_zh: 不用再对着国知局格式要求手工调字体、编号和附图。输入交底书，输出带仿宋正文、黑体标题。
tagline_en: Stop hand-formatting CNIPA specs. Feed it your disclosure, get a .docx with FangSong body, black headings, OMML.
desc_en: Generate Chinese patent specifications (中国专利说明书) as well-formatted Word documents (.docx) following the standard structure (技术领域 / 背景技术 / 发明内容 / 附图说明 / 具体实施方式). Provides reusable Python helpers for OMML inline equations, FangSong + Times New Roman fonts, black-headed Heading 1/2 styles, equation-aware tables, embedded patent-style block diagrams (parallelograms for data, dashed module groups, orth
why_zh: 公式以OMML原生嵌入Word而非图片，附图用代码生成可编辑框图。
why_en: Equations embed as native OMML, diagrams are code-generated and editable, and styles follow CNIPA guidelines exactly—not a.
limit_zh: 只产出中文专利申请的说明书初稿，不含权利要求书、摘要附图；需要你已有技术交底书文本；框图仅支持数据流/模块分组样式。
limit_en: Outputs only CN spec draft (no claims, no abstract figure). Requires your disclosure text. Diagrams limited to data-flow/module-group styles.
title_en: Tech disclosure to Word patent draft with FangSong.
